Three Arrested After Assault on Woman from Nagaland at Delhi Hotel

Three individuals, identified as Divyanshu, Gaurav, and Mohit, have been arrested following an assault on a woman from Nagaland and her friends in the parking lot of a five-star hotel in Chanakyapuri, Delhi. The attackers allegedly used a hockey stick and iron rods during the incident, with reports also mentioning an attempt to abduct the woman in a Mercedes. The woman was reportedly subjected to molestation.
